description:
🚀 Team Khonshu's Coders is passionate about space exploration, science, and technology. We aim to build an immersive Space Mission Design Game using React, Python, and 2D/3D technologies.

We welcome creative thinkers, developers, designers, and space enthusiasts. We are especially looking for skills in Three.js, game development, UI/UX, astronomy, physics, and orbital mechanics.

No expert-level experience required—just curiosity, creativity, and teamwork!

🌌 Think Beyond the Universe!
summary:
**TON618 — Mission Control: Design. Simulate. Explore.**

TON618 is an interactive, browser-based space mission design and simulation game developed to make space engineering accessible and engaging. Players take on the role of mission directors, designing spacecraft, selecting scientific payloads, planning orbits, managing resources, and simulating missions to achieve scientific objectives.

The project addresses the NASA Space Apps Challenge by transforming complex mission-design concepts into a hands-on learning experience. It combines interactive 2D visualizations, 3D spacecraft and planetary environments, and a Python-powered simulation engine to demonstrate engineering trade-offs involving mass, power, propulsion, communication, and mission budgets. It also emphasizes authentic NASA/JPL scientific references and SI units to encourage scientifically grounded learning.

TON618 is important because it bridges the gap between theoretical space science and practical engineering. By allowing users to experiment, make decisions, and learn from mission outcomes, it inspires students and aspiring space enthusiasts to explore aerospace engineering and scientific problem-solving.
